final_candidates.decision_summary: Replaces polar threonine with hydrophobic isoleucine in the HA2 stalk helix, potentially improving core packing and thermostability in the coiled-coil region.
Replaces glycine with alanine near the fusion peptide region of HA2, reducing backbone conformational entropy and stabilizing the folded state through restricted phi/psi angles.
Removes an Asn-Gly deamidation hotspot (positions 464-465) in the HA2 stalk, reducing chemical degradation over time and improving environmental persistence.

stop_reason.detail: Verified all positions against the sequence and selected three candidates with distinct stabilizing mechanisms; further iteration unlikely to improve without external evidence.

history.rationale: Isoleucine substitution at a surface-exposed position in HA2 may improve hydrophobic packing within the trimer interface, enhancing thermostability.
T318 is in the HA1 globular head; isoleucine substitution may improve hydrophobic packing but position is surface-exposed, limiting stability gains.

T318I in the HA2 stalk region replaces a polar threonine with a hydrophobic isoleucine, potentially improving core packing and thermostability. Position 318 is in the helical stalk domain where hydrophobic substitutions often stabilize.
